source: BK5 printed p.2 = book5-6.pdf PDF p.8, image-read; ER-28
note: The image-read wires and diagram implement equality (lamp ON when both switches are on the same side) under any uniform switch polarity. The printed LEFT/RIGHT example is the inverse, a manual defect, and is not asserted. ER-28 proves toggling but not absolute phase. All four absolute expectations therefore carry FALLBACK-V-EXP1-TOPOLOGY.
